title: Introduce failure-injection plugins and tenant-isolated runners for load/perf harness
creator: Asha Patel
description: Background: Our perf/load evaluation harness has accumulated brittle coupling between scenario drivers, shared global state, and a single-threaded chaos layer. This manifests as intermittent flakiness in the regression suite (esp. cross-tenant runs), opaque timeouts during spike tests, and lengthy debugging cycles. Goal: introduce a lightweight failure-injection plugin model and run-per-tenant isolation for runners so we can simulate network/storage/gpu faults deterministically and reduce cross-talk between tenant workloads. This ticket covers design, initial implementation, and migration of a small set of regression scenarios to prove the approach.
acceptance_criteria: New plugin API defined: implements lifecycle hooks (setup, before_request, after_request, teardown) and is loadable via config
At least three built-in failure-injection plugins: latency-jitter, drop-requests, and gpu-oom-sim that can be toggled per scenario
Runner process isolation per tenant: each tenant scenario runs in its own ephemeral process/container with separate seed state and no shared in-memory caches
Regression suite runs for the golden perf benchmarks with identical seeds on ref and canary with <2% flakiness reduction observed across 50 runs
CI triggers that previously ran a single combined job are split: tenantized jobs show independent pass/fail and artifacts include per-tenant logs and traces
Migration docs and a small migration script (python) exist that converts 3 representative legacy scenarios to the new format
implementation_plan: Design plugin API and configuration format (confluence: /confluence/display/INF/Failure+Injection+Plugin+Design)
Add plugin loader to harness bootstrap (pluggable via --plugins path or harness.yaml.plugins)
Implement three core plugins: latency-jitter (param: p50/p95 add ms), drop-requests (param: probability), gpu-oom-sim (simulate OOM at token N)
Refactor runner to support process-per-tenant, extract seed/PRNG into serialized per-run snapshot, remove global KV cache mutation during scenario initialization
Add deterministic fault-replay harness that can record and replay plugin events for failure reproduction
Update CI to add tenantized matrix and new smoke tests to validate isolation and plugin loading
Migrate 3 scenarios: short-chat-16k, streaming-burst, and embeddings-batch to demonstrate reduced flakiness
Create dashboards: failure-injection toggles, per-tenant flakiness rate, and mean time to repro (MTTR) from recorded traces
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Process-per-tenant increases resource usage in CI — Mitigation: start with small tenant set and add autoscaling rules for runner pool
Risk: Plugins may be abused to mask regressions — Mitigation: restrict plugin toggles in protected branches; require PR justification and review
Risk: Replaying failures may not perfectly match production nondeterminism — Mitigation: capture seeds, random streams, and environment metadata alongside plugin events
Risk: Upgrading runtime deps (locust/grpc/async framework) could introduce new regressions — Mitigation: pin and smoke-run new dep versions in canary CI before wide rollout
